title: Toward Fairness in Text Generation via Mutual Information Minimization based on Importance Sampling
reasoning: The paper focuses on mitigating social bias (specifically gender bias) in pretrained language models like GPT-2. While the authors mention religious bias as a category of social bias in the introduction, the proposed method and the experimental benchmarking (using the BOLD and Wiki-text datasets) focus on gender and professional occupations, without a specific component dedicated to evaluating religion, faith, or ethical/moral systems.
